title: A tokenizer with no unknown token
summary: Which byte or word scheme can encode any string.

choices.text: Byte-level BPE. The base vocabulary is the 256 bytes, and BPE merges are learned on top, so every byte string has a tokenization.
A whitespace word tokenizer with a fixed 50,000-word list, which never splits a word into pieces.
SentencePiece Unigram, which is BPE under another name. The two training algorithms are the same.
Character BPE whose seed vocabulary is a list of Unicode characters, with an <unk> for anything left off that list.
